description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate the application database from Oracle Database to Azure Database for PostgreSQL
tasks.reason: The application currently uses Oracle Database with Oracle-specific JDBC driver (ojdbc8), Oracle SQL dialect, and Oracle-specific features. Migrating to Azure Database for PostgreSQL removes the Oracle dependency, reduces licensing cost, and enables passwordless authentication via Managed Identity on Azure.
tasks.requirements: Migrate the Spring Boot data layer from Oracle Database to Azure Database for PostgreSQL. Replace the Oracle JDBC driver with the PostgreSQL driver. Update the JPA dialect from OracleDialect to PostgreSQL dialect. Convert any Oracle-specific SQL syntax (in repository queries, schema DDL, and Oracle-init scripts under oracle-init/) to PostgreSQL-compatible equivalents. Configure the datasource to use passwordless Managed Identity authentication. Ensure the application.properties and application-docker.properties datasource configuration is updated.

tasks.description: Migrate photo binary storage from Oracle BLOBs to Azure Blob Storage
tasks.reason: Photo files are currently stored as binary BLOBs directly in Oracle Database, which is inefficient for large binary content, increases database size, and is not a cloud-native pattern. Azure Blob Storage provides scalable, cost-effective, and purpose-built object storage for binary files.
tasks.requirements: Migrate photo binary storage from Oracle BLOB columns to Azure Blob Storage. Add the Azure Blob Storage SDK dependency to pom.xml. Update PhotoServiceImpl to upload photo files to an Azure Blob Storage container instead of storing byte[] in the database. Update photo retrieval (serving photo data to the client) to stream from Azure Blob Storage. Update photo deletion to remove blobs from Azure Blob Storage. Remove the photoData (byte[]) column from the Photo entity and replace with an Azure Blob Storage URL or blob name reference. Use Managed Identity for authentication to Azure Blob Storage. Update application configuration to include the Azure Storage account endpoint.

tasks.description: Scan all project dependencies for known CVEs and remediate identified vulnerabilities
tasks.reason: Before deploying to production on Azure, all known security vulnerabilities in project dependencies must be identified and remediated to ensure the application is secure.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade vulnerable dependencies to the minimum patched version. If a CVE fix requires a major version upgrade, document the affected dependency, the current version, the upgraded major version, and the breaking change risk. Verify that the project builds and all tests pass after remediation.

tasks.description: Containerize and deploy the PhotoAlbum application to Azure Container Apps
tasks.reason: The application needs to be deployed to Azure to complete the cloud migration. Azure Container Apps provides a fully managed serverless container environment well-suited for this Spring Boot web application.
tasks.requirements: Deploy the PhotoAlbum Java application to Azure Container Apps using the existing Dockerfile. Provision the necessary Azure Container Apps environment and container app resource. Configure environment variables for Azure PostgreSQL connection (using Managed Identity), Azure Blob Storage endpoint, and Spring active profile. Ensure the container app is accessible via HTTPS.
